mcpc-2023.notes: The two QOJ dashboards are Div. 1 (13 problems: A ABC String, B Balanced Tree Path, C Cramming for Finals, D Ordered Problem Set, E Eccentric Excursion, F Matrix Fraud, G On-Call Team, H Range Editing, I Item Selection, J Sequence Guessing, K Streets Behind, L Segment Drawing, M Champernowne Verification) and Div. 2 (13 problems: A ABC String, B Balanced Tree Path, C A Cappella Recording, D Ordered Problem Set, E Acceptable Seating Arrangements, F Four Die Rolls, G Rampant Growth, H Triple Sevens, I Item Selection, J Sequence Guessing, K Streets Behind, L Training, M Champernowne Verification). Neither matches the catalogue's 12-problem list and letters (A Rampant Growth ... L Matrix Fraud); Tournament Matchmaking and Diverse Contest from the catalogue appear in neither division. QOJ files both under Mid-Central, South Central and Southeast USA as one shared contest. The statements attachment was not captured.

mcpc-2024.notes: Fifteen Kattis problem pages, titles matching the catalogue's A-O. Only four (Cascade Centrality, Connectedness, Pascal Multiple, Up and Down) name the Mid-Central Regional 2024 as source on Kattis; nine name the Rocky Mountain Regional Programming Contest 2024 and two (Guard Evaders, Which Number Kind Is It?) the North Central Regional Programming Contest 2024. Kept as confirm since the titles are in this contest's problem list; a human may want to check that the set was shared.
